Historical dated contracts/reports and frozen execution notes received integrity/context review, not exhaustive historical semantic re-audit.
Schema property inventories and large machine crosswalk retention checks are structural coverage, not independent semantic proof of every leaf.
Current observations reuse specifically qualified PR49/PR50 source/dossiers; no fresh product tests or target experiments occurred.
General U0-U7, every full M1-M17/MC/SP/G exit, exact current target facts and atomic predicate flattening remain open.
The context assembler retains October13 roster contracts and emits that historical routing; it was compatibility-checked, not repurposed as a current task dispatcher.
The 160 canonical spec.md headings and 15 separate Opus OSR-1014 headings are distinct indexes; neither is a flattened atomic predicate denominator.
